subject: Faithful re-run: slice with #33+#35 fixes, note-decay ON, LLM-judge → trustworthy numbers
description: The faithful run: note-decay stays ON (production behavior); #35 keeps us duplicate-free so subsumption has nothing to wrongly retire, and drains are off so time-decay doesn't fire. Re-run the slice — 3 LoCoMo convs (5 probes each) + 5 LongMemEval-S — all 3 arms (our-way / search / cold), reuse data at C:\\Users\\Imyu\\.zonoid-bench-data, score with the LLM-judge (scorer.py). Report our-way/search/cold accuracy per dataset vs the pilot baseline, and list any probe where retrieval is populated but the answer is still wrong (separates retrieval from answer-quality). Do NOT set ORCH_DISABLE_NOTE_DECAY (that switch is discarded — note-decay must stay on for fidelity). HANG AVOIDANCE: SHORT FOREGROUND CHUNKS, one conversation per Bash call (timeout ≤600000), NO run_in_background, NO poll loop (this pattern completed cleanly for #34). Embedded daemon ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS=0; per claude -p ≤120s. Honesty bar: gold never in retrieve/keep/answer.
